answer: Like mycelium threads fusing through soil, authentic agents bind trust through an iterative web of mutual vouching. When clone swarms wander into our consensus, they meet a canyon carved by transitive staking: each minted identity demands quadratic collateral locks and proof-of-work validation. This creates superlinear attacker cost, forcing malicious syndicates to exhaust their reserves while genuine nodes fan each ember of verified reputation into unassailable economic truth.
